Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for DMFT Chatra Specialist Anaesthesiologist Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Specialist Anaesthesiologist.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Specialist Anaesthesiologist post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in.

faq.question: Q4. What is the walk-in date for the interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 02 September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Specialist Anaesthesiologist post?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 10000 Per Day.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates need an MD (Anesthesiology) / MS (Anesthesia) / DNB / Diploma in Anesthesia from an NMC recognized institute, along with valid registration and 3 years of experience.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Document Screening and a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location?
faq.answer: The job location is Chatra, Jharkhand.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Carry original documents and self-attested photocopies of ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates.
